unit_attributes.statement: In accordance with § 164.306, a covered entity or business associate must implement policies and procedures to limit physical access to its electronic information systems and the facility or facilities in which they are housed, while ensuring that properly authorized access is allowed (Standard: Facility access controls).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate

unit_attributes.statement: In accordance with § 164.306, as an addressable implementation specification for facility access controls, a covered entity or business associate must establish (and implement as needed) procedures that allow facility access in support of restoration of lost data under the disaster recovery plan and emergency mode operations plan in the event of an emergency (Contingency operations).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate
unit_attributes.scope_text: In accordance with § 164.306, as an implementation specification for facility access controls

unit_attributes.statement: In accordance with § 164.306, as an addressable implementation specification for facility access controls, a covered entity or business associate must implement policies and procedures to safeguard the facility and the equipment therein from unauthorized physical access, tampering, and theft (Facility security plan).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate
unit_attributes.scope_text: In accordance with § 164.306, as an implementation specification for facility access controls

unit_attributes.statement: In accordance with § 164.306, as an addressable implementation specification for facility access controls, a covered entity or business associate must implement procedures to control and validate a person's access to facilities based on their role or function, including visitor control, and control of access to software programs for testing and revision (Access control and validation procedures).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate
unit_attributes.scope_text: In accordance with § 164.306, as an implementation specification for facility access controls

unit_attributes.statement: In accordance with § 164.306, as an addressable implementation specification for facility access controls, a covered entity or business associate must implement policies and procedures to document repairs and modifications to the physical components of a facility which are related to security (for example, hardware, walls, doors, and locks) (Maintenance records).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate
unit_attributes.scope_text: In accordance with § 164.306, as an implementation specification for facility access controls

unit_attributes.statement: In accordance with § 164.306, a covered entity or business associate must implement policies and procedures that specify the proper functions to be performed, the manner in which those functions are to be performed, and the physical attributes of the surroundings of a specific workstation or class of workstation that can access electronic protected health information (Standard: Workstation use).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate

unit_attributes.statement: In accordance with § 164.306, a covered entity or business associate must implement physical safeguards for all workstations that access electronic protected health information, to restrict access to authorized users (Standard: Workstation security).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate

unit_attributes.statement: In accordance with § 164.306, a covered entity or business associate must implement policies and procedures that govern the receipt and removal of hardware and electronic media that contain electronic protected health information into and out of a facility, and the movement of these items within the facility (Standard: Device and media controls).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate

unit_attributes.statement: In accordance with § 164.306, as a required implementation specification under device and media controls, a covered entity or business associate must implement policies and procedures to address the final disposition of electronic protected health information, and/or the hardware or electronic media on which it is stored (Disposal).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate
unit_attributes.scope_text: In accordance with § 164.306, as an implementation specification for device and media controls

unit_attributes.statement: In accordance with § 164.306, as a required implementation specification under device and media controls, a covered entity or business associate must implement procedures for removal of electronic protected health information from electronic media before the media are made available for re-use (Media re-use).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate
unit_attributes.scope_text: In accordance with § 164.306, as an implementation specification for device and media controls

unit_attributes.statement: In accordance with § 164.306, as an addressable implementation specification under device and media controls, a covered entity or business associate must maintain a record of the movements of hardware and electronic media and any person responsible therefore (Accountability).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate
unit_attributes.scope_text: In accordance with § 164.306, as an implementation specification for device and media controls

unit_attributes.statement: In accordance with § 164.306, as an addressable implementation specification under device and media controls, a covered entity or business associate must create a retrievable, exact copy of electronic protected health information, when needed, before movement of equipment (Data backup and storage).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate
unit_attributes.scope_text: In accordance with § 164.306, as an implementation specification for device and media controls

unit_attributes.statement: In accordance with § 164.306, a covered entity or business associate must implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems that maintain electronic protected health information to allow access only to those persons or software programs that have been granted access rights as specified in § 164.308(a)(4).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate

unit_attributes.statement: Under access control implementation specifications, in accordance with § 164.306, a covered entity or business associate must assign a unique name and/or number for identifying and tracking user identity (Unique user identification; Required).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate

unit_attributes.statement: Under access control implementation specifications, in accordance with § 164.306, a covered entity or business associate must establish (and implement as needed) procedures for obtaining necessary electronic protected health information during an emergency (Emergency access procedure; Required).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate

unit_attributes.statement: Under access control implementation specifications, in accordance with § 164.306, a covered entity or business associate is addressed to implement electronic procedures that terminate an electronic session after a predetermined time of inactivity (Automatic logoff; Addressable).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate

unit_attributes.statement: Under access control implementation specifications, in accordance with § 164.306, a covered entity or business associate is addressed to implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt electronic protected health information (Encryption and decryption; Addressable).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate

unit_attributes.statement: In accordance with § 164.306, a covered entity or business associate must implement hardware, software, and/or procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity in information systems that contain or use electronic protected health information (Standard: Audit controls).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate

unit_attributes.statement: In accordance with § 164.306, a covered entity or business associate must implement policies and procedures to protect electronic protected health information from improper alteration or destruction (Standard: Integrity).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate

unit_attributes.statement: Under integrity implementation specifications, in accordance with § 164.306, a covered entity or business associate is addressed to implement electronic mechanisms to corroborate that electronic protected health information has not been altered or destroyed in an unauthorized manner (Mechanism to authenticate electronic protected health information; Addressable).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate

unit_attributes.statement: In accordance with § 164.306, a covered entity or business associate must implement procedures to verify that a person or entity seeking access to electronic protected health information is the one claimed (Standard: Person or entity authentication).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate

unit_attributes.statement: In accordance with § 164.306, a covered entity or business associate must implement technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to electronic protected health information that is being transmitted over an electronic communications network (Standard: Transmission security).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate

unit_attributes.statement: Under transmission security implementation specifications, in accordance with § 164.306, a covered entity or business associate is addressed to implement security measures to ensure that electronically transmitted electronic protected health information is not improperly modified without detection until disposed of (Integrity controls; Addressable).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate

unit_attributes.statement: Under transmission security implementation specifications, in accordance with § 164.306, a covered entity or business associate is addressed to implement a mechanism to encrypt electronic protected health information whenever deemed appropriate (Encryption; Addressable).
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate
